<!--
The design package already contains an argued case for killing this project. Adding to it
is a contribution, not an attack — so state the strongest version of your point.

If your argument is that the gate can be BYPASSED, that is a security report: email
instead, per SECURITY.md. Do not post it here.
-->

**The claim you're attacking**
What the design says, or what the site promises.

**Why it fails**
The mechanism. "This breaks when…" rather than "this might not scale."

**What it would cost to fix**
If you know. A proposal with a named trade-off is worth more than an elegant one without.

**What would change your mind**
Optional, and the most useful field here. If there's a measurement that would settle this
either way, naming it is worth more than the argument.
